dedupe_keys.name: dublin metropolitan area existing protected cycle infrastructure 2025

description: Dublin Metropolitan Area Existing Protected Cycle Infrastructure 2025 is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. This data set shows where protected cycle facilities exist in Dublin Metropolitan Area on both sides of the road. It included segregated Cycle Tracks, Protected Cycle Lanes, signed Quietways on low speed and low trafficked streets, and vehicular traffic free links and Urban Greenways. This database no longer includes bus lanes or painted cycle lanes. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Dublin Metropolitan Area, cycle infrastructure, dublin bikes. It offers 9 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, KML, PDF, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
